testcases.title: Test cases
testcases.subtitle: Prompt + data = a test case. Tick a few (☐ in the card corner) to fire them off together as a series.
testcases.empty: Nothing to see here. Add your first test case or loosen the filter.

testcases.editor.dataHint2: to drop the data in a specific spot – otherwise it gets tacked onto the end inside

testcases.run.notePh: e.g. after making the prompt more specific
